hypotheses.name: the loop gain crosses one before the runaway
hypotheses.prediction: in >= 80% of diverged coarse champion cells the rolling gain crosses one at or before onset
hypotheses.statement: divergence is preceded by a sustained direct error-feedback gain above one

hypotheses.name: stable cells stay below one
hypotheses.prediction: in >= 80% of non-diverged coarse champion cells the rolling gain never crosses one
hypotheses.statement: a champion cell that does not diverge never sustains a loop gain above one

hypotheses.name: the gain rises on quantized targets, not on smooth ones
hypotheses.prediction: (a) the champion's median gain over steps (160, 280) exceeds its median over (40, 160) in >= 80% of coarse_no_switch cells, and (b) on bouncing cells the median gain over steps [40, 1120) has magnitude < 0.5 in >= 80% of cells
hypotheses.statement: the one-step gradient pushes the gain upward when the displacement deviations alternate, and has no such push on smooth motion

hypotheses.name: the learning rate sets the pace, not whether
hypotheses.prediction: on coarse_no_switch, lr 0.01 over 3360 steps diverges in >= 50% as many cells as the champion does over the first 1120 steps of the same cells
hypotheses.statement: a smaller learning rate delays the runaway instead of preventing it

hypotheses.contradicted_by: a median ratio below 1.2 or above 10.0
hypotheses.name: the drift rate is proportional to the learning rate
hypotheses.prediction: on coarse_no_switch cells where both arms cross, the median ratio of lr-0.01 to champion crossing steps lies in [1.5, 6.0]
hypotheses.statement: time to cross one scales roughly inversely with the learning rate (0.03 / 0.01 = 3)
